name: outstand
description: Publish and schedule social media posts, manage connected accounts and media, and retrieve analytics with Outstand.

interface.longDescription: Use Outstand to publish and schedule posts, manage connected social accounts, upload media, and retrieve post and account analytics. Built for creators, marketers, and developers managing their own authorized accounts. Requires an Outstand account and connected social accounts. Available actions and metrics depend on each social platform's capabilities and permissions.
defaultPrompt: Show my scheduled social media posts.
Summarize the performance of my recent posts.
